declaration.title: Seller declaration
declaration.text: I confirm that all information and photos in this ad are true and current, that I own the property or am authorised by its owner to offer it, that I have the right to publish these photos, and that the phone number, the property's location and any personal data in the ad are published with their owners' consent. I undertake to provide proof of ownership or authorisation when the platform or the competent authorities ask. I alone am fully responsible for the ad's content and any dealing that results from it. I know that a false declaration may expose me to legal liability, and that the platform may provide this declaration and my data to the competent authorities. I understand that the platform's acceptance of the ad only checks it against the Posting Policy and does not mean it verified its details, my ownership or my role.

about.title: About Aqar
about.intro: Aqar is a listings site for property in Jordan only: apartments, villas, houses, land, shops and offices for sale and rent, simple and fast.
about.reviewText: Our team reviews every listing against the posting policy before it appears: photos, description, price and location. The system flags repeated photos, blocked numbers and suspicious text, and every listing ends after {d} days unless its owner renews it, so old ads don't linger.
about.searchText: Choose the deal, then the property type, then the governorate and area. More than 370 areas across the 12 governorates, with search by name.
about.verifiedText: The badge shows on offices whose documents we have seen: commercial registration, real-estate office licence and the owner’s or manager’s ID. It is renewed every year and can be removed if a violation is confirmed.
about.safetyText: Never pay anything before viewing the property and checking the papers. If a listing looks suspicious, tell us with the “Report” button on its page.
about.disclaimer: Approval for publishing only means the listing was reviewed against the posting policy; it does not mean the platform verified its details, or the advertiser’s ownership or role. The “Verified office” badge only means the office’s documents were seen; it is not a guarantee of any listing or dealing.

pricing.title: Prices and services
pricing.intro: Posting is free for individuals. To stand out, feature your listing or move it to the top; offices get monthly packages and the “Verified office” badge.
pricing.freeText: Everyone can have up to {n} listings live at the same time, for free and after review. Each listing stays up for {d} days and can be renewed; once a property is sold or a listing withdrawn, you can post another.
pricing.featureText: Shown in the “Featured listings” block at the top of the home page and matching search results, with a “Featured” label.
pricing.bumpText: Your listing goes back to the top of the list as if just published.
pricing.officesIntro: A page for your office with all its listings, more active listings, and featured listings every month.
pricing.officePage: Office page with all your listings
pricing.verifiedText: Upload your office documents in “My office”. Once reviewed, the badge shows next to your office name on all your listings for a year, and visitors can choose to see verified offices only.
pricing.order1: Offices: create your office page in “My office” and upload the verification documents.
pricing.order2: Contact us with the listing number or office name and the service you want.
pricing.order3: Transfer the amount (CliQ or eFAWATEERcom) and send us the payment reference; we activate the service and you get a notification.
